Title: Rishabh and the Family

Cast

1. Rishabh - 12 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Neeta - 41 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Savitri - 72 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair
4. Aditi - 13 years, daughter
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair
5. Kunal - 12 years, friend
Look: red T-shirt, jeans

Places

1. The park - green grass, swings, benches

Scene 1: The park - Day

[Rishabh stands in the park. Neeta stands near him.]

Rishabh: "Mom, what's the plan today?"

[Rishabh goes down the slide.]

Rishabh (excited): "One more time!"

[Rishabh plays with his dog.]

Neeta (laughing): "I really enjoyed today."
